caption: This drawing, rendered in sepia and black ink, depicts a circular basement ventilator with a decorative, radial grille design, resembling a stylized flower at its center, encased in a stone or brick wall. Fine lines radiate outward from the center of the grille, dividing the circle into segments, with a circular floral motif in the middle. The stone or brick wall surrounding the ventilator is shown with surface cracks. To the right of the main view, there is a rectangular inset with a smaller-scale elevation drawing of a building wall section, which includes a double-shuttered window above and the ventilator installed in the wall below. The main drawing includes a vertical dimension arrow labeled as "1' 1 1/4"", indicating the height of the ventilator. The bottom of the composition is labeled "BASEMENT VENTILATOR" in uppercase, hand-lettered script. The overall drawing is enclosed within a single-line rectangular border. The materials and shading are minimal, relying on line work and light washes for emphasis.
title: Cast Iron Basement Vent
